description: This file defines the class VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper, which adjusts frame release timestamps for smoother video playback by synchronizing with display vsync signals using Choreographer. It includes internal classes for sampling vsync timestamps and methods for timestamp adjustment based on playback rate and drift detection.

classes.name: VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper
classes.description: A utility class to adjust video frame release times for smoother playback by aligning with display vsync signals.

classes.name: VSyncSampler
classes.description: A singleton class that samples display vsync timestamps using Choreographer, shared across instances of VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper.

methods.name: adjustReleaseTime
methods.description: Adjusts a frame's release timestamp based on presentation time, unadjusted release time, and playback rate, aligning with vsync to improve smoothness.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the timestamp adjustment helper, starting vsync sampling if applicable.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the helper and stops vsync sampling.

methods.name: onSynced
methods.description: Hook method called when synchronization occurs; default does nothing.
